item.blurb: Wonderscent Raises $2.25M Pre-seed. Wonderscent raises $2.25M in pre-seed funding to expand its AI-powered fragrance discovery and recommendation platform for perfume shoppers.
Kunstig Aero Raises $270,000 Pre-seed. Kunstig Aero raises $270,000 in pre-seed funding from Althing Ventures to develop its AI-powered aviation safety and monitoring technology.
Listener.com Raises $500,000 Pre-seed. Listener.com raises $500,000 pre-seed round led by Aristotle Loumis to scale its AI-powered omni-channel campaign reporting platform for the podcast industry.
NCredible Secures Seed Investment. Ncredible secures seed funding from Kakao Ventures and The Ventures to advance its AI-powered operational software for the food manufacturing industry.
XEBO.ai Raises $10.5M Series A. XEBO.ai raises $10.5 million in Series A funding from Emirates Growth Fund to advance its AI-native experience management platform and scale globally.
Mechademy Raises $9.5M Series A. Mechademy raises $9.5M Series A led by Silverton Partners to expand its AI-native predictive analytics platform for power generation fleets.
SenseNet Raises $43M Series B. SenseNet raises $43 million in a Series B round led by Idealist Capital to expand its international operations and wildfire detection platform.
